name: B10-0567/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It asks Azerbaijan to free three jailed scholars: Bahruz Samadov, Igbal Abilov and Fazil Gasimov. It says their trials were unfair and their charges made up. It also asks the European Union to suspend energy trade with Azerbaijan and freeze cooperation talks until all political prisoners are freed.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- The three scholars and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan are affected.
- The European Union and member states are asked to act on trade, funding and sanctions.
